description:
## What
Add the NameConstraints OID constant and register it in HANDLED_CRITICAL_OIDS so the critical-extension check in pkix-path does not reject certs that carry it.

## Algorithm
- Add `const OID_NAME_CONSTRAINTS: ObjectIdentifier = ObjectIdentifier::new_unwrap("2.5.29.30");` in pkix-path/src/lib.rs
- Add `OID_NAME_CONSTRAINTS` to the `HANDLED_CRITICAL_OIDS` array/slice

## Acceptance criteria
- A cert with critical NameConstraints does not return UnhandledCriticalExtension
- Constant is private (pub(crate) or module-local)
title: Add OID_NAME_CONSTRAINTS to handled critical OIDs
